nothingOpen: Nothing is still open, nothing on record is waiting on you.
nothingOnRecord: I don’t have anything on that yet. If you capture it as a note on the Memories page, I’ll remember it and can answer next time.

ambiguity.silentPreamble: I have nothing about this in your sources. What follows is general knowledge, not from your sources.
ambiguity.fanoutIntro: That could mean more than one thing in your sources:
ambiguity.more_one: {{count}} more subject matched. Ask about it by name to see it.
ambiguity.more_other: {{count}} more subjects matched. Ask about one by name to see it.

smallTalk.greeting: Hi! What can I help you with?
smallTalk.farewell: Take care, I’ll be here when you need me.
smallTalk.ack: Great. Anything else I can help with?

research.prepared: I've prepared a research query, nothing has been sent yet. Proposed query: "{{query}}" ({{reason}}) Edit or approve it right here in the conversation (or later from the Research page). only what you approve leaves this instance.
research.failed: I couldn't set up that research just now. Try again from the Research page.

skillBrief.preparing_one: I'm preparing a brief on "{{subject}}". I've checked what you already know and proposed {{count}} search: nothing has been sent yet. Open the run on the Skills page to approve or edit the search plan, and watch each step as it happens.
skillBrief.preparing_other: I'm preparing a brief on "{{subject}}". I've checked what you already know and proposed {{count}} searches: nothing has been sent yet. Open the run on the Skills page to approve or edit the search plan, and watch each step as it happens.
skillBrief.failed: I couldn't prepare that brief just now. Try again from the Skills page.

reply.noneForTarget: I couldn't find a recent email from "{{target}}". Open the email in Cogeto and use "Draft reply" on it, and I'll write a suggested response.
reply.noneAtAll: I couldn't find a recent email to reply to. Open the email you mean and use "Draft reply" on it.
reply.drafted: I've drafted a reply to {{recipient}}. Open the Approvals page to review it, then send it from your own mail client, Cogeto never sends mail for you.
reply.draftedUnknownRecipient: I've drafted a reply, but this message looks forwarded and I couldn't work out the original recipient. Open the Approvals page, set the recipient, then send it yourself, Cogeto never sends mail.
reply.failed: I couldn't draft that reply just now. You can open the email and use "Draft reply" on it.

lens.nothingInProject: I have nothing about that in {{project}}. This conversation answers from that project's sources only, and your memory outside it may hold the answer.
lens.silentPreamble: I have nothing about this in {{project}}'s sources. What follows is general knowledge, not from your sources.
